collectionMethod: Manual capture around 10:40–10:45 Beijing time / 02:40–02:45Z on 2026-11-25 of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, which 302-redirects to /console/go), the documentation markdown export (https://opencode.ai/docs/console/go.md), the prerendered documentation HTML (https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models). All surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-24 captures of the same URLs. Every price, limit, estimate and sentence below is transcribed as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official catalog only. The change observed on 2026-11-25 is that the models API go.monthly_usage block for Kimi K3.1 Pro published a higher monthly limit than the 2026-11-24 capture: Go $15 → $60, Go Plus $60 → $120, Go Teams $20 → $65. The three-part token price is unchanged (input $2.00, output $10.00, cache read $0.20, cache write $2.00 per MTok). The Go landing-page model table for the same model still shows the previous tier — Est. requests / 5 hr Go: 147 and Go Plus: 588, Monthly limit Go: $15 and Go Plus: $60 (no Go Teams column) — with visible text identical to the 2026-11-24 capture and no 'New' or 'Limited time' label. The models API and the landing page therefore disagree on this model's monthly limit; both readings are recorded exactly as published and this file does not adjudicate between them. Research-only — not adopted; no computed allowance, no monthlyYi, no blended price, no script change, no leaderboard/score data.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted. The opencode_go × kimi-k3.1-pro adopted row already exists in data/adopted.csv and is still computed at the $15 monthly limit as 0.51 亿 (51,000,000 tokens, standard workload), with data_date 2026-10-30 and its evidence pointing to opencode-go-kimi-k31-pro-round1-2026-10-24.json. This file changes neither data/adopted.csv nor scripts/build_adopted.py nor any derived output. Whether and when to move the adopted value to the models-API tier (Go $60) is left to the maintainer, in particular because the Go landing page still publishes the $15 / $60 tier for this model and this file does not decide which surface is authoritative. The adopted value is not derived from the models-API figures recorded here, and the landing-page figures are not rewritten from the models-API figures.
